The Geomorphon Landforms tool calculates the geomorphon pattern of each cell of an input surface raster and classifies them into common landform types.

The elevation raster that will be used for calculations.

The distance unit that will be used for the Search distance and Skip distance parameters. The default is Cells.

The distance away from the target cell defining the radius of the area used to identify the geomorphon pattern. The default is 10 cells.

The distance away from the target cell where the analysis area starts. It must be smaller than the Search distance parameter value.

The threshold (in degrees) below which the target cell will be classified as flat. The default is 1 degree.

The linear unit of vertical z-values.

The name of the landforms raster layer that will be created and added to the map.

The name of the geomorphons raster layer that will be created and added to the map.

The type of output that will be created. The output can be a tiled imagery layer or a dynamic imagery layer.

The name of the folder in My content where the result will be saved.
